mapper.insert: INSERT INTO check_in_record (course_id, publisher_id, publish_time, deadline, end_time, attendee_count, status, score_value) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{publisherId}, #{publishTime}, #{deadline}, #{endTime}, #{attendeeCount}, #{status}, #{scoreValue})
